The '''Dawn Temple''' was a remote sanctuary built by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]], on a plateau of [[Mount Tellec/Legends|Mount Tellec]].

==History==
[[File:Dawn_Temple.png|thumb|left|250px|The temple layout]]
The Dawn Temple was intended as a spiritual retreat for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that had lost their way so that they could reconnect with the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. The temple was built after greater numbers of Jedi had to stay on Spintir, and was called the "Dawn Temple" because those who were treated there would return to the light. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many Jedi stayed at the temple, and some of the darker ones had to be placed in [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis fields]]. While the last [[Unidentified caretaker (Dawn Temple)|caretaker]] traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Reles]] for supplies after surviving the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], he was killed. The temple fell into disrepair, and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Rav Naaran/Legends|Rav Naaran]] was left in stasis.

The temple did not have a large staff, but instead used three distinct intelligences stored in [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]: the [[Curator (Dawn Temple)|Curator]], the [[Jailor (Dawn Temple)|Jailor]], and the [[Warden (Dawn Temple)|Warden]]. The Curator took the [[Color/Legends|silvery-blue]] form of an elderly [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] wearing simple [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. He was designed for the day-to-day management of the temple, and oversaw the temple's records and archives. The Warden took the form of a female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], and oversaw the defense of the temple, external and internal, but also contained combat training routines, and the method to construct a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. She appeared to be made of golden light, had a topknot protruding from a crown of horns, and wore armored Jedi robes with a lightsaber. The Jailor was made of pure, white light, and appeared as a short, elderly male [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]]. He was designed to oversee the rehabilitation of the fallen Jedi and could override the commands of the other two intelligences.

[[File:ContainmentField-EotFLotDS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A thrall of Rav Naaran restrained in one of the temple's containment fields]]

==Behind the scenes==
The Dawn Temple appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] game line. The players' duel with Naaran can result in his death, recapture, or escape, although the Temple survives regardless.
